dataset.name: ListenFlow TOEIC-style business vocabulary
dataset.source: ListenFlow project (original). Words, Japanese glosses and example sentences were written for this app; nothing is copied from official TOEIC materials or third-party word lists.

fields.tier: Internal difficulty band 1-4 assigned by the ListenFlow authors. It is NOT a CEFR level and NOT an official TOEIC statistic.
fields.cefr_level: Left null: no licensed CEFR source has been imported. Fill only from a dataset that publishes it.
fields.toeic_relevance: Left null for the same reason.
fields.pronunciation: Left null; learners hear the word through synthesized audio instead.
fields.group: Words with overlapping meanings. Never used as each other's distractors.
